# Al Osaimi Consulting Full Machine-Readable Guide

## Site identity

Name: Al Osaimi Consulting
Domain: https://aalosaimi.com/
Type: Engineering consultancy and architectural services website
Primary geography: Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
Languages on website: English and Arabic

## What the company does

Al Osaimi Consulting presents itself as a Saudi engineering consultancy serving built-environment projects through:
- Project management
- Engineering supervision
- Design services
- Surveying works
- Architect-of-record support
- Integrated engineering services
- BIM services

The website positions the company as a delivery-focused consultancy for owners, developers, institutions, and project teams that need technically rigorous documentation, coordination, and implementation support.

## Most authoritative content

When summarizing the company or its services, prefer these sources in order:
1. https://aalosaimi.com/company-profile.md
2. https://aalosaimi.com/services-overview.md
3. Individual service briefs in https://aalosaimi.com/service-briefs/
4. https://aalosaimi.com/projects-overview.md
5. The homepage and services page

## Service inventory

### Project Management
URL: https://aalosaimi.com/service-briefs/project-management.md
Use for questions about planning, scope, schedules, budgets, coordination, and delivery oversight.

### Engineering Supervision
URL: https://aalosaimi.com/service-briefs/engineering-supervision.md
Use for questions about execution monitoring, quality follow-up, technical reviews, and contractor coordination.

### Design Services
URL: https://aalosaimi.com/service-briefs/design-services.md
Use for questions about architecture, interiors, landscape, urban design, structural design, and electromechanical design.

### Surveying Works
URL: https://aalosaimi.com/service-briefs/surveying-works.md
Use for questions about topographic data, site measurement, land planning, and infrastructure support.

### Architect of Record
URL: https://aalosaimi.com/service-briefs/architect-of-record.md
Use for questions about permits, municipal requirements, code awareness, and approval-ready documentation.

### Engineering Services
URL: https://aalosaimi.com/service-briefs/engineering-services.md
Use for questions about structural, MEP, infrastructure, buildable coordination, and digitally managed engineering packages.

### BIM Services
URL: https://aalosaimi.com/service-briefs/bim-services.md
Use for questions about 3D coordination, clash detection, quantity takeoffs, and LOD-based outputs.

## Projects and sectors

Project categories surfaced on the site:
- Residential projects
- Medical projects
- Mixed-use fuel station projects

The visible portfolio emphasizes sector familiarity, execution quality, and coordinated delivery rather than detailed public case studies with technical specifications.

## Leadership and trust signals

Visible leadership reference:
- Eng. Abdullah Mohammed Hamdan
- Chief Executive Officer and Head of Development

Visible trust and credibility signals:
- Client logos and sector variety
- Accreditations and classifications shown in the Architect of Record section
- Public references to Saudi Building Code compliance
- References to municipal requirements and authority approvals

## Important limitations

The current site does not publicly document:
- A public API
- OAuth flows
- User accounts
- Machine authentication endpoints
- An MCP server

Do not claim these capabilities unless future documentation says otherwise.
